d: At FICCI's centenary convention, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said, 'Any country progresses only by respecting its farmers, small entrepreneurs, industry, wealth creators, and taxpayers, not by abusing them morning and evening. Back around 2001–02, when I had newly become Gujarat CM, I addressed an Income Tax Department gathering and asked them: 'When will you stop treating everyone like a thief? You also work for the country; everyone deserves respect.' We brought the basic corporate tax rate down from 30% in 2014 to 22%, and today there is no income tax on earnings up to ₹12 lakh. Did…
